```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r DMP, all-cause}
all_cause_model_log_URXOP1_adj <- svycoxph(
  formula = Surv(permth_exm, mortstat) ~ log(URXOP1_crt)+ RIDAGEYR+sex+URXUCR + race+edu+pir+mvp_label+bmicat+smk_label+SDDSRVYR+alcg_label,  
  design = analysis_URXOP1_crt.imputed.cont
)%>% tbl_regression(exponentiate = TRUE) 


all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_numbers=all_cause_model_log_URXOP1_adj$table_body %>% filter(term=="log(URXOP1_crt)") %>% 
  select(term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>% 
  mutate(
    Metabolite="DMP",
    Outcome="All cause",
    HR=round(estimate, digits=2),
         CI_low=round(conf.low, digits=2),
         CI_high=round(conf.high, digits=2),
    HR_CI=paste0(HR, " (", CI_low, ", ", CI_high, ")")) %>% 
  select(Metabolite, Outcome, term, HR_CI, p.value)

all_cause_model_URXOP1_quartile_numbers


```
